## User story

**As an** operations lead,
**I want** a critical heat event published automatically when a zone reaches HVI 8.0,
**so that** downstream responders can act on its location and urgent cooling interventions.

## Acceptance criteria

**AC1 — Inclusive critical threshold**
Given a report with HVI at or above 8.0,
when alert dispatch is requested,
then a Pub/Sub event is published to the environment-configured topic and its resolved message ID is returned.

**AC2 — No below-threshold event**
Given HVI below 8.0,
when alert dispatch is requested,
then no event is published and the result is an empty message ID, without creating a publisher for that call.

**AC3 — Actionable metric event**
Given a critical report with a cooling plan,
when an event is published,
then its UTF-8 JSON contains zone identity, coordinates, ambient temperature in Celsius, HVI, risk, urgent interventions and UTC dispatch time, with `risk_level` and `zone_id` attributes and no image bytes or credentials.

**AC4 — Best-effort failure policy**
Given publisher creation, publication or acknowledgement fails,
when dispatch is attempted,
then a safe diagnostic is logged and an empty message ID is returned without failing the completed analysis.

## Tasks

- [x] Encode report data as UTF-8 JSON and return a resolved message ID on successful publication
- [x] Read topic configuration and build the topic path with `publisher.topic_path`
- [ ] Add the inclusive 8.0 threshold guard before client creation
- [ ] Remove eager shell configuration and cache a lazy module-level publisher
- [ ] Select the event fields, urgent actions and UTC dispatch timestamp explicitly
- [ ] Set the required risk and zone-ID message attributes
- [ ] Handle publisher construction and acknowledgement failures safely with a bounded acknowledgement wait
- [ ] Add offline threshold, payload and failure tests

## Current state

The original dispatcher serializes the whole report, creates a publisher on every call and waits on `future.result()` without a timeout. STORY-007 is blocked on unverified foundation prerequisites.

| Defect                                                                                      | Impact                                                          |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| No dispatcher threshold guard                                                               | Any direct caller can publish below-critical reports            |
| Eager `os.popen` default and per-call publisher construction                                | Imports require a shell and clients are not reused              |
| Client construction and topic-path creation sit outside the failure handler                 | A cloud setup failure can still break analysis                  |
| Whole-report payload lacks explicit `dispatched_at`; attributes are `alert_type` and `zone` | Required event provenance and subscriber filters are incomplete |
| Unbounded acknowledgement and printed raw exceptions                                        | Request work can hang and diagnostics may leak cloud details    |

The API's deleted-field guard, BUG-008 (P0, estimate 1), separately prevents any critical event from reaching this dispatcher; it is folded into STORY-010 in [US-05.2](US-05.2-upload-an-image-and-receive-a-full-heat-report.md). Fixing this service alone does not repair that caller. Follow the [GCP service instructions](../../instructions/gcp-services.instructions.md); no subscribers, SMS or email are added.

## Test cases

| Test                                                             | Asserts                                                               |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `test_critical_hvi_publishes_and_returns_message_id`             | HVI 8.0 and higher publish successfully to the configured topic       |
| `test_subcritical_hvi_does_not_create_publisher_or_publish`      | Scores just below 8.0 produce no event                                |
| `test_heat_alert_contains_required_metric_fields_and_attributes` | JSON and attributes contain actionable fields and safe UTC provenance |
| `test_publisher_and_acknowledgement_failures_return_empty_id`    | All expected cloud failures preserve analysis and log safely          |

## Definition of done

All four cases pass with mocked Pub/Sub, the threshold includes exactly 8.0, client construction is lazy and cached, and coverage remains at least 70%. A manual integration check demonstrates a real message ID separately from offline QA. STORY-008 owns the report dispatch flag.
